sub_sector.value: Household disposables; flexible packaging closures; geosynthetic construction products

manufacturing_type.detail: Foil and film converting, with production of finished bags, plates, cups, zippers, and sliders.

production_model.detail: Branded and private-label household products supplied for retailers’ shelf assortments.

product_complexity.detail: Primarily everyday foil, wraps, bags, and disposable tableware, alongside engineered geocells and reclosable packaging components.

production_role.detail: Makes branded household goods, supplies private-label products for retailers, and manufactures zippers and sliders for flexible packaging.

end_market_exposure.detail: Household goods and consumer packaging, plus geocells for site stabilization, roads, railroads, oil and gas, and mining.

notes: Manufacturing type and production model are inferred from the product mix and retail availability.
